Miguel (Infra): heads-up — daily dashboard just spiked for us-west-2 GPU spend, +42% vs yesterday. per-model breakdown points to /generate on llama-13b-quant.
Elaine (FinOps): saw that. Per-route cost view shows dedicated-pool consumption skyrocketed between 03:00-03:30 UTC. Did reserved capacity not apply? :thinking:
Sunita (CloudOps): Checked infra events — autoscaler added nodes at 03:10 UTC. Billing export shows on-demand charges after reserved pool reached limit. snippet from logs:
```
2025-11-15T03:10Z - pool:redwood-dedicated-usw2 provision p4d: 4 -> 9
billing_tag: reserved_scope=redwood-dedicated-usw2
usage_type: on_demand (fallback)
```
Miguel (Infra): we had a commitment for 8 GPUs in us-west-2 under contract ID C-2025-11-USW2. Why provision >8?
OpsBot: Incident: capacity_fallback triggered for pool=redwood-dedicated-usw2 at 2025-11-15T03:12Z. reason=reserved_pool_exhausted (auto).
Brian (SRE): quick hypothesis — routing policy for v2-gpt-route sent canary traffic to dedicated pool instead of hosted fallback. Canary caused sudden burst. Check route_policy_v2 config and canary weights.
Elaine (FinOps): Action items: 1) verify committed capacity tagging and SOC -> billing mapping; 2) reconcile todays billing export with FinOps dashboard per-model breakdown; 3) add committed_utilization metric to daily report.
Miguel (Infra): posting a quick BigQuery example to pull tagged charges: 
```
SELECT invoice_month, project, labels, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `redwood_billing.gcp_export`
WHERE DATE(usage_start_time)=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 0 DAY)
AND labels.pool = "redwood-dedicated-usw2"
GROUP BY invoice_month, project, labels
```
Sunita (CloudOps): I'll attach the CSV export and update the FinOps dashboard thresholds. Proposal: committed_utilization = reserved_hours_used / reserved_hours_purchased. Alert when utilization <0.7 (underused) or >1.05 (overflow to on-demand).
Elaine (FinOps): love that metric. Also want per-model chargeback column so product teams see which routes drive on-demand spend. Can we retro-run for last 7 days?
Miguel (Infra): yes — will produce a 7-day per-model-per-route cost table and share link. Also will patch route_policy_v2 to ensure canary traffic uses hosted fallback pool.
Brian (SRE): I'll bring routing logs, canary config, and SRE runbook for capacity fallback to the sync.
Elaine (FinOps): Scheduling a 30-min sync 14:00 PT today. @Miguel (Infra) @Brian (SRE) please be there with logs and the billing export. :calendar: 
OpsBot: Reminder: daily billing export job completed at 04:00Z and is available in gs://redwood-billing/exports/2025-11-15.csv
Miguel (Infra): noted, grabbing the CSV now and starting reconciliation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
